title: Workflow rules
summary: How Claude works day to day: plan mode for bigger tasks, picking skills itself, editing over creating, questions through AskUserQuestion.
benefit: Claude plans bigger changes first and asks its questions in one clear place.
solves: Big changes started without a plan, questions lost inside long replies, and stray new files.
use_cases: A task that touches 3 or more files: Claude plans first (plan mode) without being told.
Claude checks the skill list before the first action and uses every skill that fits, even unasked.
Questions come only through the question dialog (AskUserQuestion), never buried in a reply.
Existing files are edited instead of new ones created; no comments or README updates unless asked.
Claude never starts python or node without a script, which can loop and fill the disk.
details: This rule shapes how Claude works day to day: it enters plan mode automatically when a task will touch 3 or more files, picks fitting skills without being asked, prefers editing existing files over creating new ones, asks you its questions through the AskUserQuestion tool and never starts a bare interpreter. "Notify sessions" means the sessions on this PC only. It loads as a text rule in every session; no code runs.
risk: Text only, loaded into every session. No code runs.
